server.description: The factory's library: chosen documents on scrubbers, air, measurement methods, CO2 and people, and the installation, to look a number or a method up rather than guess it; and the reference graphs of the station, each with its words, for a harness to instantiate on the twin
server.instructions: List the catalogue, search it with a few words, read a document whole. Every document is a file of the repository with its sha256; what is read is in the broker's trace.

list.title: The catalogue
list.description: Every document of the library: id, title, a summary, the quantities a method card measures, sha256 and size.

methods.title: Methods that measure a quantity
methods.description: The method cards of the library that measure the given quantity (Volume, AirChange, VolumetricFlow...): id, title, summary, what each measures. A card holds the method's principle and its rules of application; read it with read.

properties.quantity: the quantity to measure, as the inventory names it

search.title: Search the library
search.description: The documents the query's words appear in, the most matched first, with the lines they appear on. Read a document whole with read.

properties.query: a few words: a quantity, a method, a device, a limit
properties.limit: how many documents at most (5 when absent)

facts.title: The typed facts
facts.description: The facts the library's documents state, typed: id (scrubber.singlePassEfficiency), semantic (SinglePassRemovalEfficiency), quantity, unit, value, a band when the document gives one, and the register property that carries the same fact. A known constant cites one by id (factId); two ratios are not the same fact.

properties.id: one document's facts; all when absent

read.title: Read a document
read.description: One document whole, as markdown, with its sha256.

properties.id: the document's id, from list or search

graphs.title: The graphs on the shelf
graphs.description: The reference graphs a harness may instantiate on the twin, each with its words: what it is and how to use it, its variables (default, bounds, status: known and held, fitted, or a band) and its settings (who is on board), its probes and the telemetry columns they are judged against, the document and the template with their sha256. Instantiate one with graph.evaluate {graph: id, variables, fit, settings}.

properties.grammar: the wording key of your session (_meta.grammar of your initialize, such as claude:en or default:fr); the baseline when absent

graph.title: One graph of the shelf
graph.description: One reference graph whole: its words, its variables, settings and probes, and its template (the parametric spec the harness resolves: node parameters as formulas over the variables, the measured inputs as telemetry columns, the persons of the roster by module).

properties.grammar: the wording key of your session; the baseline when absent

library://catalogue.name: Catalogue
library://catalogue.description: The documents of the library, with their sha256

library://graphs.name: Graphs
library://graphs.description: The reference graphs on the shelf, with their baseline words
